_description: Per-gate mode knob for all 6 assistant-layer hard gates. Modes: off|announce|deny. Final referee landing mode is announce for every gate until supervised real-deny E2E proves safe deny-flip.
_kill_switch: Set any gate to 'off' to disable it instantly. Set to 'announce' to downgrade from deny without losing fire telemetry.

G0.incident: 2026-07-13 /assistants ON was theater for 2 days — flag with no liveness proof changed no behavior
G0.ramp_criterion: zero false positives across first 5 sessions with liveness-proof present on every flagged change; kill-switch reverts to announce on any false positive

G1.incident: 2026-07-13 source-proven: /assistants on|off only writes assistant-state.json; sole consumer picks a reminder string; no PreToolUse gate enforces delegate-by-default
G1.ramp_criterion: S0 severity — targeted for immediate deny flip; currently in announce as supervised ramp phase; kill-switch is the safety valve

G2.incident: 2026-07-13 rival-fight + interrogate + pre-exec audit + guilty-until-proven are prose Claude can skip; no structural gate enforces them
G2.ramp_criterion: zero false fires across 20 real weight-worthy actions with full envelope presence
G2.ramp_note: S0 gate currently in announce as supervised ramp phase; deny flip pending ramp_criterion met

G3.incident: 2026-07-13 isolation verified once at setup but not a standing gate; account-switch could change behavior silently; personal-path writes not gated
G3.ramp_criterion: S0 severity — targeted for immediate deny flip; currently in announce as supervised ramp phase; narrow scope (out-of-perimeter paths) keeps false-positive risk low

G4.incident: 2026-07-13 raw Task/Agent dispatch seen without duty-stack inheritance, depth-cap, budget cap; workers get more permissions than the envelope authorized
G4.ramp_criterion: zero false fires across 20 real agent dispatches with full wrapper compliance

G5.incident: 2026-07-13 Stop hook WARNS only; no PreToolUse gate blocks next work until final-q + Receipt + lesson clear the debt — closure stops when owner reminds
G5.ramp_criterion: zero false fires across 10 real goal completions with debt-clear flow confirmed
